a look. It is a little floppy here on the right hand side. I think maybe I don't have

fly. It's about a two-thirds rain fly on this side. And you've got mesh coming up
to maybe about about a foot below the rain fly. So you've got plenty of coverage.
Also notice these little guy outs that you can hold down tight or out like this
for ventilation to get more ventilation. Today it's cold. I think I would probably
hold them down against the tent if I could to let less air go in. Walking on
around you can see there's no doors on the back or a window. It's just a basic
one door tent, but it is nine by nine and that's enough for three people. Let's take a

there, but anyway there it is. And now let's continue looking around. The orange
rain fly casts an orange shadow and we're losing the light today, but you can see
that you have quite a bit of coverage between the mesh and the fly. That looks
like almost a foot of overlap. So no rain is going to be getting in except
here on the back you've got less. Here on the back I'd say you've got about
only about three inches of overlap, but still it looks like you're pretty well
protected from rain. Up above I do not think they gave us a gear hanger, but
maybe they did. See these little loops here? Those indicate that you could get a
gear hanger. I didn't look in the box, but it's very possible that we got a gear
hanger. And the door notice this dark gray, that's a screen. The top part
unzips. So you'll have rain protection at the bottom, but you can undo the
screen at the top and that'll be nice. And to fold it back you use these loops to
hold it in place. I think that's most of the demo for this tent. And notice that
the door is wide enough that you could put an air bed in here easily. You might
have to fold a queen bed, but a twin bed air bed you could put in easily. And
yes, I think this would fit a queen bed, although you wouldn't have much space
for a lot of other things. You could easily put some camping pads in here.
Okay, that is it. Well, let's go get a last look. Maybe I can find that, that hammock. I

tent. They're very popular. They're one of the most popular that Academy
